description: The plot, titled "BBQ," illustrates the relationship between the number of demonstrations and accuracy for four different configurations. The x-axis is labeled "#Demonstrations" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1500, with tick marks at regular intervals of 250. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and uses a linear scale with visible tick marks at 45, 50, and 55. The "Squared-Exponential" configuration is represented by a solid dark blue line with circular markers; it starts at an x-value near 30 with an accuracy of approximately 53, rises to about 55.8 at x=250, remains relatively steady with a slight dip to 55.7 at x=750, and ends at x=1500 with a value of approximately 56.2. The "Tanh" configuration is shown as a solid medium blue line with circular markers, beginning near x=30 at an accuracy of roughly 48.2, maintaining a steady trend with a slight dip to 47.9 at x=750, and concluding at x=1500 with a value of approximately 48.0. The "ELU" configuration is depicted by a solid light purple line with circular markers, starting near x=30 at an accuracy of about 46.3 and remaining nearly flat across the entire range, ending at x=1500 with a value of approximately 46.4. Finally, the "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" configuration is represented by a reddish dash-dot line without markers, which maintains a constant accuracy value of approximately 43 across the entire x-axis range.
